verdict.rationale: Neon explicitly documents a project-per-agent/tenant model 'at large scale,' with the API managing 'tens of thousands (in some cases, millions) of projects programmatically,' automated provisioning/cleanup, ephemeral idle-cost-free databases, and cost efficiency via scale-to-zero; it also ships CLI, Management API, and MCP tooling (create/delete/restore projects and branches) plus an anonymous agent-claim flow for provisioning before a human even signs in. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of actual fleet sizes in production and concrete unit-economics figures at thousand-plus scale beyond vendor docs.
